pages.title: Goblins
text: Small, quick and spiteful, goblins come one or two at a time and go straight for you.

pages.title: Two kinds
text: A goblin has **18 health** and **1 armour**, is quick, and hits for **4**.

pages.title: Fen Goblin
text: A scrawny, big-eared goblin with a reed spear, found in the Reed Fen. It rises on the open ground at night.
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 Gold Nuggets, up to 1 Bone and up to 1 String.

pages.title: Tunnel Goblin
text: A hunched goblin with a spiked club and a candle stuck to its cap, found in the dark tunnels under the Steppe, where it rises day or night.
Hunted, it also drops up to 2 Coal, up to 2 Iron Nuggets and up to 1 Bone.

pages.title: What they give
text: A Fen Goblin drops **1 to 2 Goblin Ears** (lime dye), a Tunnel Goblin **1 to 2 Goblin Fangs**, more with Looting. Both are Hound reagents: anointed, they make a weapon drink back part of every blow. See [reagents](reagents).

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting.
